about: Kimberley is a city in British Columbia’s East Kootenay, in the Purcell Mountains north of Cranbrook, a former Sullivan Mine town reinvented around the Bavarian-themed Platzl and Kimberley Alpine Resort. About 8,000 people live in Kimberley.
seoSummary: East Kootenay mountain city—former Sullivan Mine town with the Platzl and Kimberley Alpine Resort north of Cranbrook.
knownFor: Purcell Mountains city north of Cranbrook
